headlines.title: Israel rejects Trump’s 15-point plan for Gaza, Netanyahu says
headlines.description: Israel will not accept the 15-point plan for Gaza set out by President Donald Trump’s Board of Peace, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said Sunday.

headlines.title: Iran sets steep demands to reopen Hormuz despite hopes Oman deal could break impasse
headlines.description: There are no ongoing negotiations between Tehran and Washington, Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said Sunday, after Tehran set out a steep series of demands for the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz.

headlines.title: Abdul El-Sayed says he spoke with Obama after primary win, hopes he’ll campaign for him
headlines.description: In an interview with Meet the Press, Michigan Democratic Senate nominee Abdul El-Sayed says he “really enjoyed” his recent conversation with former President Barack Obama and hopes he’ll campaign with him ahead of the general election.

headlines.title: Boat captain arrested after vessel capsizes near Statue of Liberty, killing woman and child
headlines.description: A woman and a 5-month-old baby died after a boat capsized near Liberty Island in the New York Harbor Saturday night.

headlines.title: American surgeon restores sight to thousands at war-torn border of South Sudan
headlines.description: An American eye surgeon and his team performed over 1,000 cataract surgeries in Abyei along the South Sudan border, restoring sight to thousands in a region with one of the world's highest blindness rates. NBC News' Molly Hunter reports.

headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.

headlines.description: An Indian national was arrested and charged with murder after fleeing the country as police investigated the death of his 19-year-old girlfriend in Tucson, Arizona.
